record.reason: TRACE is a training-free inference-time hallucination correction algorithm, but its primary full text reports substantial added inference cost: extra intermediate-layer output projections and mean 2.27x wall-clock latency versus baseline. It has a possible connection to inference-time decoding/correction lineages, but it is not an efficiency improvement and the measured overhead weakens scope fit.
record.title: TRACE: Trajectory Correction from Cross-layer Evidence for Hallucination Reduction
